recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If Structured Documents later wants a dedicated nested-section instance example for teaching purposes, handle it as a new editorial/example-improvement task rather than as a required reconciliation of this DSTU1 publication-prep issue.
issue_request: FHIR-5495 was a Published FHIR-core Composition change request from the January 2015 ballot, resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked for more detail about how Composition maps to CDA and scenarios/examples for narrative-only sections, sections with narrative plus entries, and subsections; the final disposition said related comments handled most of the comment except that examples needed to be provided before final publication.
initial_application: No source text or git commit directly referencing FHIR-5495 was found. Nearby Composition/CDA work was applied explicitly, including FHIR-5493 in commit 9728390581527fbfe248afbde3a47bac77d46b2f, and later Composition section refactors in commits 686889f8a3b83c74a4e58ddddfac7616dd0da4ca and 749c4dd88234688f57191d3d0b4d62bdc525b87d established the current section.text/section.entry model. Current active source now contains the relevant CDA guidance and Composition examples.
additional_context: Composition is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Composition narrative links readers to the CDA-aware note and CDA comparison page, explains structural differences from CDA, and the active StructureDefinition carries CDA mappings for Composition and Composition.section, including nested Composition.section.section. Recent combined-branch reconciliations already corrected related Composition current-source drift around CDA wording, section root wording, document narrative, and the mixed example.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already provides implementer-facing CDA mapping/guidance and examples: Composition notes explicitly allow narrative-only sections, composition-example.xml demonstrates section text with supporting entries and a section with text and no entries, document-example-dischargesummary.xml demonstrates multiple narrative-and-entry document sections, and structuredefinition-Composition.xml defines recursive nested sections with constraints and CDA mappings.
